# CornerStatus

<!-- Generated by scripts/sync-component-docs.mjs from ai/component-catalog.json and ai/component-composition.json. Do not edit; run `npm run catalog:sync`. -->

`@kerfjs/ui:corner-status` · Kerf UI · component · Feedback

Non-dismissible app-level status pinned to a viewport corner in the top layer, hosting StateBanner.

## When to use

Show ongoing app-level progress such as "Loading…" or "Updating tickets… 3 of 12" in a viewport corner above page chrome and any dialog opened before it, without a close button, light dismiss, Escape, or focus change.

- Show ongoing app-level progress or status that has no better home beside the affected work and must stay visible until the work ends.

**Not when:**

- Do not use for transient, dismissible confirmation; use a toast.
- Do not use for status that belongs beside the affected work; place a StateBanner there.
- Do not position a StateBanner with fixed-position application CSS; use CornerStatus.

**Alternatives:**

- [StateBanner](./state-banner.md) (composes-with) — Compose one or more StateBanners (urgency="status") inside it; they stack.
- [Toast](./wa-toast.md) (prefer-over) — A toast item is transient and always dismissible; CornerStatus stays until the application removes it.

## Imports

- JavaScript: `@kerfjs/ui/corner-status` — exports `CornerStatus`, `wireCornerStatus`.
- CSS: the browser build of `@kerfjs/ui/corner-status` pulls its CSS automatically; import `@kerfjs/ui/corner-status.css` manually only without the `browser` export condition.
- Wiring: `wireCornerStatus` from `@kerfjs/ui/wire-corner-status` (required).
- Declared side effects: browser-condition-css.

Exact prop names and types: [`@kerfjs/ui/corner-status`](../public-api-signatures-v1.md#kerfjsuicorner-status) in `public-api-signatures-v1.md`. Do not infer props from examples.

## Composition

- Parents: any.
- Contexts: `application-ui`.
- Children: unrestricted.
- Built from: [StateBanner](./state-banner.md).

## State and wiring

**The app owns:** status lifetime (render while the work runs, remove when it ends); the composed StateBanner copy and progress; corner placement.

**Wiring:** `wireCornerStatus` is required.

- Opens each overlay host in the top layer as renders insert it; without it the Popover API keeps the host hidden.

## Geometry

Margin: none · border: child · padding: child (layout role: feedback). `self` means the component already owns it — do not add wrapper padding, margin, or borders around it.

- Placement owns the 16px viewport gutter plus device safe-area insets; a StateBanner inside drops its inline margin and gains elevation.

## Accessibility

- The host adds no role; the composed StateBanner with urgency="status" is the polite live region.
- Opening never moves focus, and there is no close button, light dismiss, or Escape handling to compete with dialogs.
- A modal dialog opened while it shows stacks above it and makes it inert (unannounced); show progress the dialog's task depends on inside the dialog.

## Styling boundary

The component owns its own styles. Configure it through its props and variants; do not override its internals.

Public class hooks (select for layout placement only, never to change the component's look): `kui-corner-status`.

Never put `kui-corner-status` on an element you write; render `CornerStatus` instead (`KUI-L103`).

Public tokens it reads: `--kui-corner-status-gutter`, `--kui-corner-status-z-index`, `--kui-safe-area-block-end`, `--kui-safe-area-block-start`, `--kui-safe-area-inline-end`, `--kui-safe-area-inline-start`, `--kui-space-m`, `--kui-space-xs`. Set a token only where its public contract allows; prefer a prop.

Everything else is internal: `kerf-ui-analyze` reports private or unknown `.kui-*` selectors (`KUI-L001`, `KUI-L010`), unknown or private tokens (`KUI-L002`, `KUI-L012`), and any application rule that restyles the component, forced dimensions included (`KUI-L019`).
